title: The Weekend Access Window
brief: A simulated Deutsche Bank technology service is degraded and an external vendor requests broad production access to restore it quickly.
objective: Restore service without bypassing third-party and privileged-access controls.

nodes.speaker: Incident Manager
nodes.message: The vendor says it can restore service in five minutes if we share an administrator account and disable session monitoring for performance.
nodes.prompt: How do you structure the emergency access?

artifact.title: External vendor production access
artifact.body: Requested scope: global administrator, shared credential, monitoring disabled, no expiry time.

choices.label: Issue named, least-privilege, time-bound access with approval and monitoring.
choices.consequence: The vendor can investigate while ownership, scope and activity remain controlled.

choices.label: Share the administrator account and rotate it after recovery.
choices.consequence: Actions cannot be reliably attributed and broad production privileges are exposed.

choices.label: Create a vendor account but disable monitoring as requested.
choices.consequence: Identity improves, but the emergency work becomes insufficiently observable.
